zh-CN.search_placeholder: 搜索镜像、配置、服务或证据…
zh-CN.graph_hint: 选择节点查看完整配置和证据；连线编号对应连接关系清单。
zh-CN.select_hint: 选择图中的节点，查看配置、来源与证据。
zh-CN.footer: 本页是生成时的结构快照。状态取自本次调查与验证记录，打开页面不会探测服务或刷新运行状态。
zh-CN.empty_lane: 本列无节点；相关缺失项请查看后续事项。
zh-CN.empty_edges: 尚未确认连接关系，请查看后续事项。
zh-CN.graph_footer: 实线：该连接已验证；虚线：其余状态。状态以记录的验证范围为准。
zh-CN.config_hint: 只读展示本次采集的配置值、来源和证据；显示偏好不会修改 sbx 配置。
zh-CN.empty_config: 没有匹配的配置记录。尚未采集的生效值不会从示例或节点说明中推断。
zh-CN.connections_hint: 编号与拓扑连线对应，点击查看关联节点及验证范围。
zh-CN.node_scope: 仅统计节点，不代表整个环境通过

en.search_placeholder: Search images, configuration, services or evidence…
en.graph_hint: Select a node for configuration and evidence. Edge numbers match the connection list.
en.select_hint: Select a node to inspect configuration, sources and evidence.
en.footer: This page is a snapshot at generation time. Statuses reflect the recorded investigation and checks. Opening the page does not probe services or refresh runtime state.
en.empty_lane: No nodes in this column. See next steps for any missing information.
en.empty_edges: No connections confirmed yet. See next steps.
en.graph_footer: Solid: verified connection. Dashed: other statuses. Check the recorded verification scope.
en.config_hint: Read-only values, sources and evidence collected for this snapshot. Display preferences do not modify sbx configuration.
en.empty_config: No matching configuration records. Missing effective values are not inferred from examples or node descriptions.
en.connections_hint: Numbers match the graph edges. Select a connection to inspect its nodes and verification scope.
en.node_scope: Node checks only; not whole-environment acceptance
